timeline.range: Browse the milestones of our history

intro.p1: With over 30 years of experience in textile programming, **Fil'ing Broderies**, founded in 1997, has always been driven by the desire to develop embroidery in all its forms.
intro.p2:
Our mission?
To rise to the challenges of personalising your products, from the **unique piece** to the **large series**.

expertise.p1: Partner to the greatest luxury houses and high-end brands, we offer our expertise across various sectors such as **leather goods**, **ready-to-wear**, **accessories**, **furnishing**, **swimwear**, **events**, **packaging...**

fabrication.title: **FRENCH MANUFACTURING**
fabrication.description: All our production is carried out in our workshops in France, near Lyon in the Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes region, the historic cradle of the textile tradition.

patrimoine.title: **LIVING HERITAGE COMPANY**
patrimoine.description: Since 2023, Fil'ing Broderies is proud to hold the "Entreprise du Patrimoine Vivant" (Living Heritage Company) label, awarded by the prefecture of the Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes region.

valeurs.title: **OUR VALUES**
valeurs.description: The involvement, commitment and above all the enthusiasm of every team member are essential concerns in the life of our company.

intro.p1: We develop your projects, whether from plans, patterns, digital files, or simply through discussion, always striving to be **as close as possible to your wishes.**
intro.p2:
Our craft, in constant evolution, demands continuous monitoring of trends and innovations.
Our **permanent** questioning allows us to present **innovative** solutions that best meet your expectations.
intro.p3: Our **Research & Development** department will be happy to answer all your requests.

dev.title: **5 DEVELOPMENT STATIONS**
dev.description: To bring your ideas to life

couleurs.title: **OVER 2000 THREAD COLOUR REFERENCES**
couleurs.description: Offering a wide choice to match your project as closely as possible

intro.p1: The demands of our clients compel us to perform.
intro.p2: We must guarantee **quality** production on time, by carrying out quality control at **every stage** of the production chain and by maintaining constant dialogue with the manufacturing sites.

preparation.title: **PREPARATION AND FINISHING**
preparation.description: A material preparation unit equipped with slitting machines, washing machines and hot presses, as well as a finishing and quality control unit

tetes.title: **99 EMBROIDERY HEADS**
tetes.description: Divided between a workshop dedicated to sampling and one dedicated to large-series production

decoupe.title: **3 CUTTING MACHINES**
decoupe.description: 2 laser cutters and 1 digital table with shape recognition

finishing.p1: Finishing is the **indispensable** final touch to our work for **impeccable** quality.
finishing.p2:
It is a craft in its own right, requiring a **precise** eye and great **attention to detail**.
Stitch by stitch, our workshop applies the final care to your products.
